trigger: A bounded 3D game-asset task or asset defect falls inside the body scope.

actions: Record project, asset, source, task, and requester identity.
Read the accepted brief, visual direction, target engine/runtime and renderer versions, platform and camera/use context, budgets, delivery format, importer contract, and provenance packet.
Separate required decisions, accepted constraints, preferences, hypotheses, and unknowns.
Map adjacent owners and required evidence surfaces.
ordered_phases.gate: All required inputs are present and non-conflicting, or the result is a bounded missing-input diagnosis.

actions: Choose direct-low, high-to-low, modular, tiling, trim-sheet, unique-texture, or other declared production paths from the brief and target evidence.
Define silhouette, proportion, scale, snap, topology, deformation, UV, texel, bake, material, LOD, collision, socket, export, import, and test checkpoints.
Define reversible save points before destructive or lossy operations.
Request decisions that belong to visual, technical, graphics, world, gameplay, QA, or IP owners.
ordered_phases.gate: The plan traces every expensive or irreversible step to an accepted need and evidence route.

actions: Build the minimum geometry needed to test dimensions, silhouette, proportion, pivot, articulation zones, snap, and target placement.
Compare at representative camera distance, FOV, and use context with a known-scale fixture.
Record visual-direction decisions and unresolved alternatives before detail production.
ordered_phases.gate: Blockout evidence supports continued production; otherwise repair, request review, or hold.

actions: Create final high/low or direct-low geometry with intentional topology and transformation state.
Lock or record triangulation, normals, tangents, smoothing, UV seams, material slots, and deformation assumptions before dependent bakes.
Build UVs and texel plan for declared material and lighting use.
Bake and inspect required mesh maps; repair localized cage, projection, skew, seam, padding, or tangent failures.
Author PBR surface inputs with explicit color spaces, channel meanings, alpha mode, resolution, compression assumptions, and provenance.
Compare the asset with its family under representative conditions.
ordered_phases.gate: The exact editable source passes declared structural and sampled visual checks without hidden blockers.

actions: Create target-declared LODs, simple collision candidates, sockets or locators, final transforms, pivots, hierarchy, naming, and material-slot layout.
Export the exact candidate with recorded DCC, exporter, format, extension, and preset versions.
Run the declared interchange validator and preserve all warnings and errors.
Do not delete unsupported data merely to make validation green; resolve, declare, or hand off it.
ordered_phases.gate: The exchange candidate is structurally valid for its declared scope, or all exceptions are explicit and accepted for testing.

actions: Import or re-import the exact candidate into the exact target build with recorded settings.
Compare source and target scale, axes, transforms, bounds, pivots, hierarchy, mesh structure, normals/tangents, UVs, materials, textures, LODs, collision, sockets, and warnings.
Observe representative lighting, cameras, distances, motion, mip and LOD transitions, and scene context.
Request target-device measurements and relevant collision, deformation, animation, gameplay, or world-context tests from owning roles.
Keep each evidence surface and non-claim separate.
ordered_phases.gate: Requested claims are directly supported or remain explicitly NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED, or handed off.

actions: Localize the failure to brief, source, bake, surface, export, import, renderer, runtime, interaction, or rights state.
Repair the smallest owned cause while preserving the prior candidate and rationale.
Invalidate and rerun every downstream check affected by the repair.
Stop when the repair crosses ownership, changes accepted meaning, or lacks a valid observation surface.
ordered_phases.gate: The repaired candidate has fresh downstream evidence and no stale pass is reused.

actions: Package editable source and dependencies, runtime candidate and import instructions, textures and material mapping, LOD/collision/socket candidates, and exact identity.
Attach budget trace, structural results, target observations, measurements, provenance, failures, repairs, limitations, non-claims, and open handoffs.
State EXPERIMENTAL, TESTED, MEASURED, VISUALLY_INSPECTED, PLAYTESTED, OBSERVED, INFERRED, BLOCKED, and NOT_TESTED only where supported.
ordered_phases.gate: Another worker can reproduce the handoff without hidden chat reasoning or missing source identity.

global_stop_conditions: Required source, brief, visual direction, target contract, budget, provenance, tool, or evidence surface is missing or ambiguous.
A requested action or acceptance decision belongs to another profession and no accepted contract delegates it.
The asset cannot be tied across editable source, export, target import, and evidence.
A change would destroy rollback, obscure provenance, or silently rewrite accepted direction.
Only structural or presentation evidence exists for a requested runtime, visual, performance, gameplay, animation, or legal claim.
